title: Ellagic acid inhibits dihydrotestosterone-induced ferroptosis and promotes hair regeneration by activating the wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
authors: Fu, Hangjie; Li, Wenxia; Liu, Jinyuan; Tang, Qiehao; Weng, Zhiwei; Zhu, Lijian; Ding, Bin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究鞣花酸通过Wnt/β-catenin通路抑制DHT诱导的铁死亡促进毛发生长，属于皮肤病学与信号通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模内容，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Androgenic alopecia (AGA) is the most prevalent form of hair loss in clinical practice and affects the physical and psychological well-being of adolescents. Paeonia lactiflora Pallas (PL), which is widely used in traditional Chinese medicine, enhances blood function and promotes hair growth, and ellagic acid (EA), a polyphenol in PL extract, shows strong antioxidant, anti-aging, and anti-inflammatory properties and also plays a role in the treatment of various skin conditions. However, its role and mechanism of action in AGA remain unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: To determine whether EA can rescue slow hair regeneration by regulating dihydrotestosterone (DHT)-induced ferroptosis in AGA mice and clarify the effect of EA on DHT-induced ferroptosis in dermal papilla cells (DPCs). MATERIALS AND METHODS: Male C57BL/6 mice were used to establish a DHT-induced AGA mouse model, whereas DPCs were used to establish a DHT-induced cellular model. Thereafter, we investigated the therapeutic mechanism of action of EA via immunofluorescence, western blot analysis, immunohistochemistry, electron microscopy, and molecular docking. RESULTS: EA stimulated hair regeneration in mice and reversed DHT-induced increases in iron content, lipid peroxidation, and DHT-induced mitochondrial dysfunction by activating the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway. Further, beta-catenin knockdown suppressed the inhibitory effect of EA on DHT-induced ferroptosis in DPCs. CONCLUSION: EA inhibits DHT-induced ferroptosis and promotes hair regrowth in mice by activating the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway. Thus, it has potential for use as a treatment option for AGA.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：雄激素性脱发（AGA）是临床实践中最为常见的脱发形式，影响青少年的身心健康。白芍（Paeonia lactiflora Pallas, PL）在传统中医中广泛使用，可增强血液功能并促进毛发生长，而鞣花酸（ellagic acid, EA）作为PL提取物中的一种多酚，具有强效的抗氧化、抗衰老和抗炎特性，并在多种皮肤疾病的治疗中发挥作用。然而，其在AGA中的作用及机制尚不明确。研究目的：确定EA是否通过调节双氢睾酮（dihydrotestosterone, DHT）诱导的脱发小鼠模型中的铁死亡（ferroptosis）来挽救缓慢的毛发再生，并阐明EA对DHT诱导的毛乳头细胞（dermal papilla cells, DPCs）铁死亡的影响。材料与方法：使用雄性C57BL/6小鼠建立DHT诱导的AGA小鼠模型，同时使用DPCs建立DHT诱导的细胞模型。随后，通过免疫荧光、蛋白质印迹分析、免疫组织化学、电子显微镜和分子对接技术，研究EA的治疗作用机制。结果：EA刺激小鼠毛发再生，并通过激活Wnt/β-catenin信号通路，逆转DHT诱导的铁含量增加、脂质过氧化及DHT诱导的线粒体功能障碍。此外，β-catenin敲低抑制了EA对DHT诱导的DPCs铁死亡的抑制作用。结论：EA通过激活Wnt/β-catenin信号通路，抑制DHT诱导的铁死亡并促进小鼠毛发再生。因此，其具有作为AGA治疗选择的潜力。
